glosses: to raise someone's hackles (make someone angry)

examples.text: By jednak nie zostawić doradców rozsierdzonych, w następne dni [król] robił im nadzieje, że po namyśle da im przyrzeczone zatwierdzenie i nadanie praw i wolności.
examples.translation: However, to not leave his advisors angry, in the following days [the king] gave them hope that, after consideration, he would give them the promised confirmation and grant of rights and freedom.
examples.english: However, to not leave his advisors angry, in the following days [the king] gave them hope that, after consideration, he would give them the promised confirmation and grant of rights and freedom.

examples.text: Mel Gibson znów rozsierdził Żydów. Reżyser chce nakręcić film o herosie judaizmu Judzie Machabeuszu. Środowiska żydowskie protestują
examples.translation: Mel Gibson has angered the Jews again. The director wants to make a movie about the Jewish hero Judas Maccabaeus. Jewish groups are protesting
examples.english: Mel Gibson has angered the Jews again. The director wants to make a movie about the Jewish hero Judas Maccabaeus. Jewish groups are protesting

examples.text: Prezydent Donald Trump zapowiedział przywrócenie 10 proc. cła na pewne wyroby aluminiowe z Kanady, aby chronić własny sektor przed skokiem importu. Rozsierdził tym Ottawę, która zapowiedziała retorsje.
examples.translation: President Donald Trump has announced an increase of 10 percent of the tariff on certain aluminum products from Canada, in order to protect his own sector against a jump in imports. By this he has angered Ottawa, which has promised retaliation.
examples.english: President Donald Trump has announced an increase of 10 percent of the tariff on certain aluminum products from Canada, in order to protect his own sector against a jump in imports. By this he has angered Ottawa, which has promised retaliation.

examples.text: Rozsierdzona G. nakazała swym pomagierom nękać sąsiada telefonicznymi pogróżkami i żądać pieniędzy.
